slides.title: Aggression at the low
slides.body: The breakdown bar prints 3 stacked sell imbalances: bid volume at least 3x the ask one tick above. Sellers are hitting the bid with size.

slides.title: No follow-through
slides.body: All that aggression should push price lower. It doesn't. The next bar can't make a new low and closes back above the broken support.
slides.tip: Aggression + no progress = someone passive is absorbing. The sellers are now trapped.

slides.title: Delta flips positive
slides.body: The reclaim bar shows stacked BUY imbalances. Trapped shorts are forced to cover with market buys, adding fuel.

slides.title: Where their stops sit
slides.body: Trapped sellers place stops above the breakdown bar high. That cluster is the first liquidity target.
slides.tip: Trigger: the reclaim. Invalidation: below the trap low. Target: the breakdown bar high.

How to spot TRAPPED traders on the footprint 🪤

A trap is not a pattern on the candle. It's a mismatch between aggression and result: heavy market selling that fails to move price. When that happens, the aggressive side is stuck and their stops become liquidity.

1️⃣ Stacked sell imbalances at the low (bid >= 3x the ask one tick above)
2️⃣ No follow-through: price closes back above support
3️⃣ Delta flips positive as shorts cover
4️⃣ Their stops above the breakdown bar are the first target
